settings.assist.title: ⏳ AI Assistance & Turn Rewind (Undo Mode):
settings.assist.chk: Enable discreet Undo button and turn rewind commands
settings.assist.desc: Enables /rewind, /deshacer, and /undo at zero cost, plus the ⏪ Undo turn button. Built to recover from AI hallucinations or misunderstandings without losing character resources.
settings.assist.warn: ⚠️ Warning: Enabling this allows meta-gaming and reverting outcomes at will, lowering the stakes of dice rolls and survival.
settings.dm_queries.chk: Save DM questions inside the campaign («Ask the DM» and /dm)
settings.dm_queries.desc: Stored in consultas_dm.jsonl and browsed or cleared from Chronicle → ❓ OOC Queries. They stay out of DM prompts and PDF exports, but travel with ZIP campaign exports.
settings.closing_recap.chk: Generate AI closing recap on save & exit («Previously on...»)
settings.closing_recap.desc: Disabled by default to save tokens and exit instantly with a local summary. When enabled, it only calls the AI after at least 3 new turns in the session.
settings.memory.title: 🧠 Memory & Recall Management (Prompt Injection):
settings.memory.card.semantic:
🧠 Contextual Semantic Similarity
✅ Pros: 100% dynamic and responsive to the current scene. Injects the memories with the strongest thematic and spatial match to your location and action.
⚠️ Cons: Runs in-memory similarity scoring once more than 5 memories accumulate.
settings.memory.card.hybrid:
⭐ Hybrid: Pinned + Recent
✅ Pros: Full player control. Starred (⭐) memories in the Chronicle are never forgotten in DM prompts.
⚠️ Cons: Requires manually pinning important memories in the Chronicle.
settings.memory.card.recency:
⏱️ Pure Temporal Recency (FIFO)
✅ Pros: 0 ms overhead, deterministic, and predictable. Injects strictly the last 5 chronological memories.
⚠️ Cons: Older crucial memories (such as an ancient oath or pact) may drop out as new ones arrive.
settings.locale.label: 🌐 Interface & Narration Language:
settings.locale.note: Updates the full interface and Dungeon Master narration immediately.
